question: What forehead-centered repetition must the god-worshipped practitioner complete as part of this secret practice?
premises: The prescribed act is a repetition numbering one hundred thousand.
This repetition is situated in the mass of letters at the forehead.
The instruction is addressed to a practitioner honored as worshipped by gods.
inference: The secret practice requires the god-worshipped practitioner to complete a hundred-thousandfold repetition focused in the forehead's letter-mass.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the varṇa-rāśi at the forehead is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: O one worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of letters at the forehead.
